grammar_title: 基本句型 Basic sentence structures(主谓宾宾 SVOO / 主谓宾补 SVOC / 主系表 SVP)
source: 外研社(新标准)必修第一册 Unit 1 Using language: Review basic sentence structures。零术语、全应用填空,句子围绕'高中新开始'主题;答案唯一(每题只有一个词能让句子成立)。

points.point: 主谓宾宾(SVOO):能带双宾语的动词(give/tell/show… sb sth)
points.overview: 有些动词后面可以接两个宾语——先接'人'(间接宾语)、再接'物'(直接宾语),如 give me a book。不及物动词(arrive/happen/stay…)后面不能带宾语,更不能带两个宾语。

points.point: 主谓宾补(SVOC):make/keep/find… + 宾语 + 形容词作宾语补足语
points.overview: make/keep/find/leave/get 等后面常接'宾语 + 形容词',形容词说明宾语的状态(make me happy)。这里只能用形容词,不能用副词、名词或不定式。

points.point: 主系表(SVP):系动词 be/feel/look/become… + 形容词作表语
points.overview: 系动词(be/feel/look/become/seem/sound/get/stay/grow 等)后面接形容词作表语,说明主语的状态(I feel nervous)。系动词后用形容词,不用副词、名词或不定式。

questions.stem: My new teacher ____ me a useful book about good study habits.
questions.explanation: give 可接双宾语(give sb sth),这里'me'与'a useful book'是两个宾语;arrive/happen/stay 是不及物动词,不能带宾语。

questions.stem: On my first day, a kind senior ____ me some helpful advice.
questions.explanation: offer sb sth 接双宾语;smile/wait/sleep 不及物,不能带'me … advice'两个宾语。

questions.stem: The head teacher ____ the new students an interesting story about the school.
questions.explanation: tell sb sth 接双宾语;come/appear/laugh 不及物动词,不能带双宾语。

questions.stem: A friendly classmate ____ me the way to the science lab.
questions.explanation: show sb sth 接双宾语;sit/run/fall 不及物,不能接'me … the way'。

questions.stem: The school ____ every new student a welcome letter before term began.
questions.explanation: send sb sth 接双宾语;arrive/happen/rise 不及物动词,不能带宾语。

questions.stem: Lisa ____ us a box of photos from her own high school days.
questions.explanation: bring sb sth 接双宾语;smile/wait/listen 不及物,不能带'us … a box'。

questions.stem: Mr Meng ____ us a simple way to stay calm under pressure.
questions.explanation: teach sb sth 接双宾语;arrive/stay/sleep 不及物,不能带双宾语。

questions.stem: The teacher ____ each of us a copy of the new timetable.
questions.explanation: hand sb sth 接双宾语;come/appear/laugh 不及物动词,后面不能跟宾语。

questions.stem: The girl next to me ____ me a pen when I forgot mine.
questions.explanation: pass sb sth 接双宾语;sit/run/fall 不及物,不能带'me a pen'。

questions.stem: A senior student kindly ____ me her notes before the first test.
questions.explanation: lend sb sth 接双宾语;arrive/happen/rise 不及物,不能带宾语。

questions.stem: At the end of the year, the school ____ her a prize for hard work.
questions.explanation: award sb sth 接双宾语;smile/wait/sleep 不及物,不能带'her a prize'。

questions.stem: The interviewer ____ Lisa several questions about her first week.
questions.explanation: ask sb sth 接双宾语;come/appear/laugh 不及物动词,不能带双宾语。

questions.stem: His encouraging words ____ me real confidence on a difficult day.
questions.explanation: give sb sth 接双宾语;arrive/stay/fall 不及物,不能带'me … confidence'。

questions.stem: The club leader ____ us a free lesson to help us decide.
questions.explanation: offer sb sth 接双宾语;sit/run/wait 不及物,不能带宾语。

questions.stem: Sarah ____ me a few easy skateboarding tricks after class.
questions.explanation: show sb sth 接双宾语;smile/happen/rise 不及物,不能带双宾语。

questions.stem: Our teacher ____ us the reason why a good start really matters.
questions.explanation: tell sb sth 接双宾语;arrive/sleep/laugh 不及物动词,不能带宾语。

questions.stem: The committee ____ every member a message about the first meeting.
questions.explanation: send sb sth 接双宾语;come/appear/sit 不及物,不能带'every member a message'。

questions.stem: Mum ____ me a warm drink while I planned my weekly schedule.
questions.explanation: bring sb sth 接双宾语;run/fall/wait 不及物,不能带双宾语。

questions.stem: The band teacher ____ us a new song for the welcome concert.
questions.explanation: teach sb sth 接双宾语;smile/happen/rise 不及物动词,不能带宾语。

questions.stem: Before the speech, Lisa ____ the host a short list of her main points.
questions.explanation: hand sb sth 接双宾语;arrive/sleep/laugh 不及物,不能带'the host a short list'。

questions.stem: The teacher's warm smile made the whole class ____.
questions.explanation: make + 宾语 + 形容词作宾补,形容词说明 class 的状态;副词 happily、名词 happiness、不定式都不能作宾补。

questions.stem: Taking a deep breath made me ____ before my speech.
questions.explanation: make me + 形容词,calm 作宾补说明'我'的状态;副词/名词/不定式都不能放在这里。

questions.stem: On the first morning, I found myself rather ____.
questions.explanation: find + 宾语 + 形容词,nervous 说明 myself 的状态;副词、名词、不定式都不能作宾补。

questions.stem: Mr Meng's advice made every new student more ____.
questions.explanation: make … + 形容词作宾补,more confident 说明 student 的状态;副词/名词/不定式不能作宾补。

questions.stem: The mystery on the noticeboard kept us ____ all morning.
questions.explanation: keep + 宾语 + 形容词,curious 说明 us 的状态;副词、名词、不定式都不行。

questions.stem: The empty campus kept everything ____ in the early morning.
questions.explanation: keep everything + 形容词作宾补;副词 quietly、名词 quietness、不定式都不能作宾补。

questions.stem: Standing on the stage made my parents very ____.
questions.explanation: make … + 形容词,proud 说明 parents 的状态;副词/名词 pride/不定式都不能作宾补。

questions.stem: After a week, I found the new classroom quite ____.
questions.explanation: find + 宾语 + 形容词,comfortable 说明 classroom 的状态;副词、名词、不定式都不行。

questions.stem: Missing the club meeting left me a little ____.
questions.explanation: leave + 宾语 + 形容词作宾补,sad 说明 me 的状态;副词/名词/不定式不能作宾补。

questions.stem: Good time management keeps a busy student ____ from too much stress.
questions.explanation: keep + 宾语 + 形容词,safe 说明 student 的状态;副词 safely、名词 safety、不定式都不能作宾补。

questions.stem: The lively welcome concert made everyone ____.
questions.explanation: make … + 形容词作宾补;副词、名词、不定式都不能放在 everyone 之后。

questions.stem: I found the debate club rather ____ about winning.
questions.explanation: find + 宾语 + 形容词,serious 说明 club 的态度;副词/名词/不定式不能作宾补。

questions.stem: Joining the sports club keeps my body ____ and healthy.
questions.explanation: keep + 宾语 + 形容词,active 说明 body 的状态;副词 actively、名词 action、不定式都不行。

questions.stem: Mr Meng's simple example made the whole lesson very ____.
questions.explanation: make … + 形容词作宾补,clear 说明 lesson 的状态;副词、名词、不定式都不能作宾补。

questions.stem: We got the classroom ____ for the welcome party.
questions.explanation: get + 宾语 + 形容词,ready 说明 classroom 的状态;副词 readily、名词 readiness、不定式都不能作宾补。

questions.stem: The teacher's question made the noisy room ____ at once.
questions.explanation: make … + 形容词,silent 说明 room 的状态;副词、名词 silence、不定式都不能作宾补。

questions.stem: I found my new desk ____ and well organised.
questions.explanation: find + 宾语 + 形容词,neat 说明 desk 的状态;副词/名词/不定式都不行。

questions.stem: Thick coats kept the whole team ____ at the outdoor event.
questions.explanation: keep + 宾语 + 形容词,warm 说明 team 的状态;副词 warmly、名词 warmth、不定式都不能作宾补。

questions.stem: Most new students found the orientation talk really ____.
questions.explanation: find + 宾语 + 形容词,helpful 说明 talk 的状态;副词、名词、不定式都不行。

questions.stem: A full timetable kept us ____ all through the first week.
questions.explanation: keep + 宾语 + 形容词,busy 说明 us 的状态;副词 busily、名词 business、不定式都不能作宾补。

questions.stem: Before introducing myself, I felt very ____.
questions.explanation: feel 是系动词,后接形容词作表语说明主语状态;副词 nervously、名词 nervousness、不定式都不能作表语。

questions.stem: After the talk, Lisa looked calm and ____.
questions.explanation: look 作系动词,后接形容词作表语;副词/名词 confidence/不定式都不能作表语。

questions.stem: When I saw the noticeboard, I became ____ about the clubs.
questions.explanation: become 是系动词,后接形容词作表语;副词、名词、不定式都不行。

questions.stem: Mr Meng told us to stay ____ under pressure.
questions.explanation: stay 作系动词,后接形容词作表语说明状态;副词 calmly、名词 calmness、不定式都不能作表语。

questions.stem: As the teacher began to speak, the whole room grew ____.
questions.explanation: grow 在此作系动词,后接形容词作表语;副词、名词、不定式都不行。

questions.stem: By Friday, I felt really ____ at my new school.
questions.explanation: feel 是系动词,后接形容词 happy 作表语;副词/名词/不定式都不能作表语。

questions.stem: My parents looked ____ when I stood on the stage.
questions.explanation: look 作系动词,后接形容词作表语;副词、名词 pride、不定式都不能作表语。

questions.stem: Mr Meng's voice sounded ____ but kind.
questions.explanation: sound 是系动词,后接形容词作表语;副词/名词/不定式都不行。

questions.stem: After making a few friends, I became more ____.
questions.explanation: become 作系动词,后接形容词 cheerful 作表语;副词、名词、不定式都不能作表语。

questions.stem: At first, the new timetable sounded a little ____.
questions.explanation: sound 是系动词,后接形容词作表语;副词 strangely、名词、不定式都不行。

questions.stem: The science lab looked clean and ____.
questions.explanation: look 作系动词,后接形容词作表语;副词 brightly、名词 brightness、不定式都不能作表语。

questions.stem: After Mr Meng's example, the rule seemed quite ____.
questions.explanation: seem 是系动词,后接形容词作表语;副词/名词 clarity/不定式都不能作表语。

questions.stem: With my new friends around, I felt ____ and welcome.
questions.explanation: feel 作系动词,后接形容词 safe 作表语;副词 safely、名词 safety、不定式都不行。

questions.stem: When I missed the team, I felt a little ____.
questions.explanation: feel 是系动词,后接形容词作表语;副词、名词 sadness、不定式都不能作表语。

questions.stem: Everyone's welcome on the first day was friendly and ____.
questions.explanation: be 是系动词,后接形容词作表语;副词 warmly、名词 warmth、不定式都不行。

questions.stem: To most of us, the orientation talk seemed very ____.
questions.explanation: seem 作系动词,后接形容词 helpful 作表语;副词、名词、不定式都不能作表语。

questions.stem: When the teacher entered, we all became ____.
questions.explanation: become 是系动词,后接形容词作表语;副词、名词 silence、不定式都不行。

questions.stem: After a good night's sleep, I felt ____ for the first class.
questions.explanation: feel 作系动词,后接形容词作表语;副词 freshly、名词 freshness、不定式都不能作表语。

questions.stem: Even when nervous, Lisa stayed ____ and friendly.
questions.explanation: stay 是系动词,后接形容词作表语;副词 politely、名词 politeness、不定式都不行。

questions.stem: Day by day, I grew more ____ about senior high life.
questions.explanation: grow 作系动词,后接形容词 eager 作表语;副词 eagerly、名词 eagerness、不定式都不能作表语。
